options.content:
One row per distinct flow over the selected time range, from Cilium's aggregated policy-verdict export. **events** is the number of connections. Filter any column from its header.

- **Policies to add:** filter *verdict* to `DROPPED`. *destination names* and *destination ip* are only filled for drops (names come from Cilium's DNS cache).
- **Policies to remove:** a policy that never appears in *policy* over a long range (30d or more; weekly and monthly jobs are rare) may be unused. Rows with an empty *policy* were allowed without one being named (host and kubelet probes, Geneve), so host-firewall policies cannot be judged here.

targets.expr:
sum_over_time(
  {namespace="cilium", container="hubble-flows"} |= "\"flow\":"
  | json verdict="flow.verdict", dir="flow.traffic_direction", reason="flow.drop_reason_desc", e="flow.aggregate.egress_flow_count", i="flow.aggregate.ingress_flow_count", ep="flow.egress_allowed_by[0].name", ip="flow.ingress_allowed_by[0].name", src_ns="flow.source.namespace", dst_ns="flow.destination.namespace", src_labels="flow.source.labels", dst_labels="flow.destination.labels", names="flow.destination_names", src_ip="flow.IP.source", dst_ip="flow.IP.destination", tcp="flow.l4.TCP.destination_port", udp="flow.l4.UDP.destination_port", icmp="flow.l4.ICMPv4.type", src_id="flow.source.identity", dst_id="flow.destination.identity"
  | label_format policy=`{{ or .ep .ip }}`, events=`{{ add (int (or .e "0")) (int (or .i "0")) }}`, port=`{{ if .tcp }}TCP/{{ .tcp }}{{ else if .udp }}UDP/{{ .udp }}{{ else if .icmp }}ICMP/{{ .icmp }}{{ end }}`
  | label_format src=`{{ or .src_ns (regexReplaceAll "^.*?\"((?:reserved|cidr):[^\"]+)\".*$" .src_labels "${1}") (printf "identity %s" .src_id) }}`, dst=`{{ or .dst_ns (regexReplaceAll "^.*?\"((?:reserved|cidr):[^\"]+)\".*$" .dst_labels "${1}") (printf "identity %s" .dst_id) }}`, names=`{{ regexReplaceAll "[\\[\\]\"]" .names "" }}`
  | label_format src_ip=`{{ if eq .verdict "DROPPED" }}{{ .src_ip }}{{ end }}`, dst_ip=`{{ if eq .verdict "DROPPED" }}{{ .dst_ip }}{{ end }}`
  | keep verdict, dir, src, dst, names, port, policy, reason, src_ip, dst_ip, events
  | unwrap events [$__range]
)
